metadata.description: God Mode skill collection for Claude Code

plugins.name: god-mode
plugins.description: Core: router, rules, token protocol, first-run category picker. Install this one.

plugins.name: gm-web-design
plugins.description: Web & Design: Clone a website into Next.js, swap a color palette across a codebase, and two reviewers for phone-width pages and dashboards.

plugins.name: gm-qa-audit
plugins.description: QA & Audit: Agents that test a mobile app before a store build and find why a site is broken or slow (CORS, 500s, routes).

plugins.name: gm-seo-writing
plugins.description: SEO & Writing: SEO and AI-crawler visibility audits, rewrite text that sounds like AI, and bilingual Arabic/English news articles.

plugins.name: gm-video
plugins.description: Video & Marketing: Promo films, trailers, shorts and captions with launch copy. Picks the right video tool for each job.

plugins.name: gm-career
plugins.description: Career: CV and LinkedIn optimizer, an ATS-aware job hunter that tailors a CV per job, and a job-site accounts registry.

plugins.name: gm-automation
plugins.description: Automation & Agents: Get data from websites through their own requests, and an office-manager agent that splits big tasks across specialists.

plugins.name: gm-study
plugins.description: Study: Turn a lecture PDF into a designed A4 study summary with mind maps, diagrams and exam questions.

plugins.name: gm-interior
plugins.description: Interior Design: Room layouts, furniture plans, bills of quantities and mood boards.
